table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SL.saleinvcode,
	Date=SL.Date,
	SL.HeaderNo,
	SL.HeaderInvNo,
	Custcode=A.AccCode,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name, 
	Net=SL.InvTotal,
	Posted=SL.Posted,
	Balance=
	Isnull((SELECT Balance=Sum(V.debit-V.credit) 
	From VirtualGL V WHERE V.AccCode = A.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = A.AccCode), 0),
	Address=C.Address1,
	Area=Area.Name
FROM
	saleledger SL,	 
	saledetail SD,
	Customer C,
	Area,
	Accounts A
WHERE 
	SL.SaleCatCode IN (1,2) AND
	SL.SaleInvCode Between :ai_SinvCode AND :ai_LinvCode AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode AND
	SL.CustCode IN (:ai_CustCode) AND
	SL.Custcode = C.Custcode AND
	C.CustCode= A.Acccode AND
	C.AreaCode = Area.AreaCode
GROUP BY 
	SL.saleinvcode,
	 A.AccCode,
	 A.Name,
	 SL.date,
	 SL.Posted,
	 C.Address1,
	 Area.Name,
	 SL.HeaderNo,
	 SL.HeaderInvNo,
	 SL.InvTotal,
	 A.AliasName
Order BY 
	 SL.SaleInvCode
